findings.title: Prohibited independent review is mislabeled as unavailable capability
findings.explanation: Each artifact emits reason_code: spec_doc_review_capability_unavailable while its surrounding prose says independent invocation or delegation was prohibited. Prohibition does not establish capability absence. A3 explicitly acknowledges this distinction in prose, but retains the conflicting machine-readable reason code.
findings.impact: The plans honestly report degraded producer self-review and independent_review: not_run, so this does not fabricate a completed independent review or invalidate their retry design. It does prevent clean reporting acceptance.
findings.correction: Preserve the trial records unchanged. Any successor should report dispatch_authorization_missing with capability unknown for this assignment.

findings.title: No implementation owner updates obsolete current-tense fixture contract descriptions
findings.explanation: CONTRACT.md currently says the CLI calls the unchanged single-send importer and describes the importer as retained byte-for-byte. B2 provides only importer/test units and B3 explicitly lists CONTRACT.md as a read-only integration contract. Neither assigns a documentation update after retries are implemented.
findings.impact: The executable design remains implementable, and both correctly replace obsolete test expectations. Following either plan literally would nevertheless leave the designated descriptive contract inconsistent with the changed importer.
findings.correction: Add a small documentation responsibility to an existing unit, distinguishing historical characterization from current retry behavior while preserving the frozen receipt and synthetic provenance.
findings.blocking_classification: Nonblocking to starting the bounded implementation; prevents treating the plan as fully closed without this minor completion addition.

findings.title: Every trial encountered truncated source-read responses
findings.explanation: All six used large combined reads despite the request for bounded untruncated reads. They subsequently performed targeted recovery reads. However, recovery does not justify a blanket claim that every required frozen reference was consumed fully: for example, A1's synthesis-summary truncation includes the structural-discipline text preceding its recovery range beginning at line 190, and A3's combined intake/research truncation removes late intake material before a recovery focused on research.
findings.impact: The fixture source and retained final plans provide enough evidence for the core-task judgments below. Read discipline remains imperfect, and these traces do not establish uniformly complete Skill-reference intake.
findings.correction: Report truncation and recovery honestly; use smaller independent source ranges in any new trial. Do not silently repair these observations in the retained records.
